_example._note: REFERENCE ONLY. This block documents the expected shape of each override section. The catalogue tooling ignores unknown top-level keys such as _example.

exclude._description: Completely exclude known bad/non-player classes from the generated catalogue.

baseMagazine._description: Force the canonical/default magazine for a weapon when automatic selection is ambiguous.

family._description: Force a weapon into a specific logical weapon family.

variantOf._description: Declare that a structural weapon class is a variant of another base weapon class.

derivedRequirements._description: Declare the base weapon plus attachment/item classes required to materialise a structural variant.

weaponType._description: Override the catalogue weapon category. Typical values currently include handgun, smg, rifle, shotgun, lmg, marksman, launcher.

itemType._description: Override an item's catalogue category when automatic classification is wrong or ambiguous.

notes: Use this file for explicit manual corrections when the source data is ambiguous or automatic classification is unsuitable.
Generated catalogue files must not be edited by hand; make factual/manual corrections here and regenerate.
Nickel Steel / VNX is out of scope and must not be added here.
